policy: All candidates are pending_validation. Public no-key endpoints are distinguished from portals whose individual datasets may have additional terms. API fair-use limits and source-specific reuse terms must be respected.

candidates.name: UN Comtrade — public trade release index
candidates.category: international merchandise trade releases and availability
candidates.accessModel: public unauthenticated preview API; fair-use limits apply
candidates.licenceEvidence: UN Comtrade public API documentation states public release and preview endpoints require no key; fair-use limits apply and full data APIs may require a subscription key.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from official UN Comtrade API documentation; public releases endpoint is explicitly documented as no-key.

candidates.name: UN Comtrade — India annual trade preview
candidates.accessModel: public unauthenticated preview API; maximum 500 records and fair-use limits
candidates.licenceEvidence: UN Comtrade documentation confirms the public preview API requires no key and is limited to 500 records; observe fair-use limits.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from official UN Comtrade API documentation; endpoint uses reporterCode 356 for India and total annual exports.

candidates.name: Eurostat — GDP dataset API
candidates.category: national and regional accounts and GDP statistics
candidates.licenceEvidence: Eurostat documents free public REST API access to statistics and metadata; verify dataset-specific reuse notice.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from Eurostat official API documentation; endpoint queries nama_10_gdp for EU27_2020.

candidates.name: UN News — all topics RSS
candidates.category: United Nations global news and institutional updates
candidates.licenceEvidence: UN News RSS feed; review UN News terms and attribution requirements before redistribution.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from UN News feed URL; feed discovery listing indicates this RSS endpoint is active. Validate against official host and parser.

candidates.name: Asian Development Bank — Data Library
candidates.category: Asia-Pacific macroeconomic, social, project and infrastructure datasets
candidates.accessModel: public data portal; dataset-level API and licence conditions vary
candidates.licenceEvidence: ADB states its Data Library hosts publicly available, machine-readable datasets and APIs; verify each dataset licence and API terms.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from ADB Data Library official About page describing public datasets and API accessibility.
